div.div:
by construction
Sv = 0 and lb ≤ v ≤ ub hold exactly at v*, the ceilings with them
v* is piecewise constant in the bounds and carries no gradient; only z* does
the forced flux of the maintenance reaction (lb 0.7 mmol/gDW/h) must be carried inside the ceilings

div.div:
measured (rounds 15 to 15d)
an infeasible program returns the zero flux and no gradient, so the state is absorbing (rounds 15b to 15d); duals on exchange bounds belong to no gene, so with no ceiling binding the backbone receives nothing (round 15b)
